title: Cross-Functional Weekly: Scope Narrowing, Unblocks & Exec Decision Log
text:
Cross-Functional Weekly: Scope Narrowing, Unblocks & Exec Decision Log

["From: priyom_das\\nTo: marissa_cole, karthik_iyer, vivek_kulkarni, lauren_bishop, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme-analytics.com>\\nCc: procurement@acme-analytics.com\\nDate: Tue, 8 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700\\nSubject: Follow-ups from CF weekly — narrowed scope proposals + exec asks\\n\\nTeam — quick write-up from this morning's cross-functional sync. I pulled together the narrow-scope proposal and a short list of exec asks we should surface for QBR. Please find the current tracker attached (QBR-asks-tracker.xlsx) and a short proposal (narrowed-scope-proposal.md).\\n\\nKey asks for visibility: \\n- Exec decision required: approve temporarily reducing feature set for initial GA to Core API + Caching (PRIORITY) — owner: marissa_cole — decision needed by 2028-05-11.\\n- Procurement: finalize Acme SOW redlines (procurement@acme-analytics.com copied) — owner: lauren_bishop — deliverable: SOW v2 by 2028-05-12.\\n- Infra unblock: confirm Dedicated capacity slot for demo load test (INF-1427) — owner: karthik_iyer — ETA 2028-05-10.\\n\\nSanjay — thanks for walking through Acme's timeline. I'll attach the SOW draft they sent (acme-sow-draft-v2.pdf) and mark the items we need to surface to leadership.\\n\\nNext step: owners confirm commitments and update the tracker by end of day Friday, 2028-05-11. Short replies are fine.\\n\\n— Priyom\\nPriyom Das\\nProduct Lead, Platform\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\nAttachments: QBR-asks-tracker.xlsx, narrowed-scope-proposal.md, acme-sow-draft-v2.pdf", "From: marissa_cole\\nTo: priyom_das, karthik_iyer, lauren_bishop\\nCc: vivek_kulkarni, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme-analytics.com>\\nDate: Tue, 8 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Follow-ups from CF weekly — narrowed scope proposals + exec asks\\n\\nThanks — I looked through the tracker and added comments on the exec ask spreadsheet (tab: Exec-Summary). Quick notes: \\n- I support the temporary scope reduction to Core API + Caching for GA. That reduces integration surface and speeds up validation.\\n- For the exec decision, want two bullets for the board: (1) customer impact (Acme timeline + expectations) and (2) mitigations (feature rollouts post-GA). I'll draft those under Exec-Summary.\\n\\nAction updates: \\n- I can draft the board bullets by 5/10 EOD — marissa\\n- I'll take the lead on sequencing the QBR slide and will need karthik's latency numbers for the demo.\\n\\nMarissa Cole\\nDirector, Product\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\n> Attachment referenced: QBR-asks-tracker.xlsx (comments added)", "From: karthik_iyer\\nTo: priyom_das, marissa_cole, lauren_bishop\\nCc: vivek_kulkarni\\nDate: Tue, 8 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Follow-ups from CF weekly — narrowed scope proposals + exec asks\\n\\nOn INF-1427: allocating a burst Dedicated slot for Acme demo is possible but requires a quick config change and a short runbook. I can schedule the slot for 2028-05-15 for the demo load test. \\n\\nShort checklist for the infra side (I added INF-1427 in the tracker): \\n- confirm demo SLOs (expected qps + latency targets) — owner: priyom_das\\n- create burst capacity runbook — owner: karthik_iyer — due 2028-05-12\\n- smoke test with reduced model variant (quantized) — owner: vivek_kulkarni — due 2028-05-13\\n\\nI'll drop the latency numbers into the tracker by EOD 5/9.\\n\\n— Karthik\\nKarthik Iyer\\nEngineering Manager, Serving Runtime\\nRedwood Inference", "From: lauren_bishop\\nTo: priyom_das, marissa_cole, karthik_iyer\\nCc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, vivek_kulkarni\\nDate: Tue, 8 May 2028 15:48:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Follow-ups from CF weekly — narrowed scope proposals + exec asks\\n\\nLooping procurement — procurement@acme-analytics.com, adding a short set of redlines we need: payment milestones, data retention clause, and liability cap alignment. Sanjay — can your legal team confirm if the milestone schedule in SOW v2 is acceptable? If not, please flag which milestones need to move.\\n\\nI'll take the SOW redline pass and return v3 by 2028-05-12. If procurement needs anything earlier, ping me directly.\\n\\nLauren Bishop\\nHead of GTM Operations\\nRedwood Inference\\n\\nAttachment: acme-sow-draft-v2.pdf (inline comments requested)", "From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme-analytics.com>\\nTo: lauren_bishop, priyom_das\\nCc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, marissa_cole\\nDate: Wed, 9 May 2028 14:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Follow-ups from CF weekly — narrowed scope proposals + exec asks\\n\\nThanks, team — appreciate the clear asks. Our legal reviewed the SOW and flagged two items: (1) liability cap needs to match our procurement policy (we can propose language), (2) milestone dates look tight given our internal review cycle — can we shift the acceptance milestone +2 weeks?\\n\\nWe're otherwise aligned on the narrow scope for the initial integration. I'll coordinate with Kate (cc'd in earlier notes) if we need to loop external partners. For now, please proceed with the SOW redline and the exec bullets; I'll aim to provide suggested liability language by Friday 5/12.\\n\\nBest,\\nSanjay Rao\\nVP Product, Acme Analytics\\n\\n---\\nForwarded message: Acme SOW v2 (attached)\\n\\nAttachments: acme-sow-draft-v2.pdf"]
